Name: Scout Buggy
Description: Fast reconnaissance vehicle. Up to 6 per team, respawn 30 s.

Name: Armored Jeep
Description: Protected light transport. Up to 6 per team, respawn 30 s.

Name: Armored Personnel Carrier
Description: Protected squad transport. Up to 4 per team, respawn 45 s.

Name: Infantry Fighting Vehicle
Armament: 30 mm autocannon, 2 ATGM, coax MG, smoke
Description: Armed troop carrier with infantry support role. Up to 4 per team, respawn 60 s.

Name: Main Battle Tank
Armament: 130 mm cannon, coax MG, commander HMG, smoke
Description: Primary heavy direct-fire platform. Up to 3 per team, respawn 75 s.

Name: Tank Destroyer
Armament: 140 mm rail cannon (casemate, limited traverse), smoke
Description: Specialized anti-vehicle platform. Up to 2 per team, respawn 75 s.

Name: Mobile Anti-Air Vehicle
Description: Mobile defense against aircraft and drones. Up to 2 per team, respawn 60 s.

Name: Self-Propelled Artillery
Description: Long-range fire support. Up to 1 per team, respawn 90 s.

Name: Logistics Truck
Armament: None; resupplies soldiers and vehicles within 15 m
Description: Carries ammunition and field supplies. Up to 2 per team, respawn 45 s.

Name: Recovery Vehicle
Armament: Roof MG; repairs vehicles within 10 m at 60 HP/s
Description: Recovers or repairs damaged vehicles. Up to 1 per team, respawn 60 s.

Name: Scout Drone
Description: Uncrewed surveillance platform. Up to 4 per team, respawn 40 s.

Name: Attack Drone
Description: Uncrewed attack platform. Up to 2 per team, respawn 60 s.

Name: Attack Helicopter
Armament: 30 mm chain gun, 16 rockets, 4 ATGM, flares
Description: Armed helicopter for close air support. Up to 2 per team, respawn 90 s.

Name: Transport Helicopter
Description: Squad transport helicopter. Up to 3 per team, respawn 60 s.

Name: Heavy Transport Helicopter
Description: Heavy lift troop transport (tandem rotors). Up to 1 per team, respawn 90 s.

Name: Fighter
Description: Fast aircraft focused on air-to-air combat. Up to 1 per team, respawn 90 s.

Name: Attack Aircraft
Armament: 30 mm rotary cannon, 6 bombs, 8 rockets, flares
Description: Fixed-wing close air support platform. Up to 1 per team, respawn 120 s.

Name: Heavy Transport Aircraft
Armament: None; flares. Air-drops one ground vehicle (up to 70 t) on a marked point
Description: Can deliver a compatible vehicle as payload. Up to 1 per team, respawn 150 s.
